newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom hits record high of 6,000 escudos.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom hits record high of 6,000 escudos.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom hit an all-time high of 6,000 escudos on Lisbon bourse amid euphoria over the telecommunications sector, dealers said.
PT shares later rose further to close at a new high of 6,100 escudos, up 7.2 percent from Tuesday.
"Now that we have broken through 6,000 escudos, everything is possible," said a dealer when asked where the share price was heading.
Dealers said investors were enthusiastic about the telecommunications sector and optimistic about PT's 1996 results.
